gaps.sentence: They agreed ___ the fence between the two gardens.
gaps.explanation: agree takes the to-infinitive: agreed to mend.

gaps.sentence: Despite ___ three times, he didn't give up.
The teacher made us ___ the whole essay again.
gaps.explanation: 'Make someone do' — active 'make' takes the bare infinitive.

gaps.sentence: If you keep ___ like this, you'll exhaust yourself.
gaps.explanation: keep (+ on) is followed by -ing: keep working.

gaps.sentence: The hotel offered ___ our room free of charge.
gaps.explanation: offer takes the to-infinitive: offered to upgrade.

gaps.sentence: The scheme aims ___ younger visitors to the museum.
gaps.explanation: aim + to-infinitive: aims to attract (aim at + -ing is also possible in BrE).

gaps.sentence: I can't wait ___ you the photos.
gaps.explanation: can't wait + to-infinitive: can't wait to show.

gaps.sentence: She admitted ___ the last train and had to take a taxi.
gaps.explanation: 'Admit doing' — confess to a past action takes the gerund.
